_comment: Hashes of the upstream artefacts every bridge document cites. Truncated to 16 hex, which is what the schema's pattern allows. Regenerate with tools/rehash.sh; a mismatch is rule R6 and it means an import is stale, not that the file is wrong.
_am_note: A sender's own plan changes between rounds -- that is the round working. The unsuffixed plan key is the r1-era file that r1 and r2 both cite and must keep verifying; '@r<N>' pins the revision a later round was distilled from. One key per round, added by the owning side, nothing overwritten. Proposed as a convention (README/schema unchanged, ownership rule).
